subtitle: A wild, cliff-backed Atlantic point break in Sintra whose "untouched" backdrop is a still-unfinished ecological park.
spike_statement: Sintra paid a bankrupt developer €500,000 for 54.6ha next to Adraga in 2021, and won't finish rebuilding the land into a park until 2027.

levers.photo_tone: Gray-green Atlantic swell under vertical ochre cliffs, sea caves in shadow, restoration scrub still low and pale against older pine.
